citation: Dolfin, S., Richman, S., Choi, J., Streke, A., DeSaw, C., Demers, A., & Poznyak, D. (2019). Evaluation of the Teacher Potential Project. Washington, DC: Mathematica (submitted to EL Education). Grantee submission, July 30, 2019. ERIC ED604655.
design: RCT; school-level random assignment within matched pairs; 70 schools (35 treatment / 35 control) in 18 high-need districts across 12 states, 3 cohorts (2014-15, 2015-16, 2016-17); intervention = Teacher Potential Project (EL Education ELA standards-aligned curriculum + embedded teacher PD) vs business-as-usual district curriculum/PD; subject = ELA/Reading; grades 4-8. Achievement analyses pooled 66 schools providing usable test data. Impact models: regression on standardized (national-norm) state ELA scores with treatment indicator, controlling for student reading & math pretest, student/teacher/school covariates, district-by-grade and year indicators, nonresponse weights; SEs account for clustering of students within schools.
problems: The report does not publish the exact in-sample pooled posttest SD used to standardize impacts; it reports only the standardized effect size (= adjusted treatment-control difference / unadjusted student-level pooled posttest SD) rounded to 2 dp, plus the unstandardized treatment coefficient (3 dp) and its SE (2 dp). Because state ELA scores were pre-standardized to a national norming population (~SD 1), the in-sample standardizing SD is near 1 but not stated, so g_se had to be derived as SE_coef * (ES/coef) per row, which compounds rounding (the implied SD = coef/ES ranges 0.85-1.5 across rows purely from 2-dp ES rounding). g_se/g_var should therefore be treated as approximate. For S1 the ES rounds to 0.00 so g_se cannot be derived from ES; it is set from the coefficient SE assuming SD~1.0. Table VI.1 reports 8 overlapping subsample contrasts from ONE RCT (one TPP treatment vs one control), sliced by exposure duration (1 vs 2 yr), teacher type (novice vs all), follow-up status, and study-vs-schoolwide population - these are NOT separate arms. The report's headline/primary student outcomes are the overall two-year impact (S4, full sample) and the two-year impact (S6, restricted to 2-year schools). The one-year impact (S2) is the clean full-sample RCT contrast but found null. A separate writing literacy task (Table VI.5 / Appendix G.13-G.15) was a researcher-made, novice-teacher-only subgroup measured at the teacher level on only 12 teachers (n=6 per group) with extreme, underpowered, non-significant effect sizes (many |g|>1); it is a researcher-made instrument (the meta-analysis used only independent measures) and is documented here but NOT extracted as effect-size rows because the values are not interpretable. The TPP one-year teacher attrition for the literacy-task analysis was 86% (RCT compromised for that subanalysis per WWC). Note: TPP delivery model is curriculum + embedded PD, so impacts conflate curriculum and PD (this is how the meta-analysis coded it under 'TPD for curricula').

effect_sizes.arm_label: TPP (EL Education ELA curriculum + embedded teacher PD) - overall two-year impact, all schools (S4)
effect_sizes.test_name: State ELA assessments, standardized to means/SDs of a national norming population
effect_sizes.timepoint: post, end of schools' second study year (combines schools with 1 or 2 years of TPP)
effect_sizes.g_method: Report's effect size (=adjusted treatment-control difference on standardized state ELA scores / unadjusted student-level pooled posttest SD) = 0.08, taken as d. Hedges' g = J*d, J = 1 - 3/(4*df-1), df = n_t+n_c-2 = 10157, J = 0.99993; g = 0.99993*0.08 = 0.07999. g_se derived from coefficient SE: standardizing SD = coef/ES = 0.084/0.08 = 1.05; g_se = J*(SE_coef/SD) = 0.99993*(0.02/1.05) = 0.01905; g_var = g_se^2.
effect_sizes.page_ref: Table VI.1 row 3 (p. 64, PDF p.79); discussion pp. 64-65
effect_sizes.notes: Report's headline overall impact across ALL study schools after two study years; positive and significant (p<0.01), robust to Benjamini-Hochberg correction and to complete-case (ES 0.09) and joiner (ES 0.09) sensitivity. ~1.1 months of growth. Coefficient is unstandardized treatment coefficient on standardized scores. n_t/n_c are student counts; 34 treatment + 32 control schools (n_clusters=66 schools contributing usable data). HLM clustering of students within schools -> SE already cluster-adjusted (cluster_adjusted=true). No ICC reported anywhere in the report.

effect_sizes.arm_label: TPP - two-year impact, schools that did two full years, students of study teachers (S6)
effect_sizes.test_name: State ELA assessments, standardized to means/SDs of a national norming population
effect_sizes.timepoint: post, end of teachers' second year of TPP engagement
effect_sizes.g_method: Report's effect size = 0.10 taken as d. J with df = 3774 = 0.99980; g = 0.09998. g_se: standardizing SD = coef/ES = 0.092/0.10 = 0.92; g_se = 0.99980*(0.03/0.92) = 0.03260; g_var = g_se^2.
effect_sizes.page_ref: Table VI.1 row 5 (p. 64, PDF p.79); discussion p. 65, 78
effect_sizes.notes: Largest reported student impact; positive and significant (p<0.01), robust to BH correction; complete-case ES 0.14, joiner ES 0.09. ~1.4 months of growth (50th->54th pctile). Restricted sample: only schools that implemented TPP for two years AND students of study teachers (not full randomized sample), so is_full_sample=false. This is a subset of the S4 overall two-year sample. Student-within-school clustering modeled -> cluster_adjusted=true.

effect_sizes.arm_label: TPP - one-year impact, all schools (S2) [clean full-sample RCT contrast]
effect_sizes.test_name: State ELA assessments, standardized to means/SDs of a national norming population
effect_sizes.timepoint: post, end of schools' first year of TPP implementation
effect_sizes.g_method: Report's effect size = 0.01 taken as d. J with df = 12857 = 0.99994; g = 0.01000. g_se: standardizing SD = coef/ES = 0.015/0.01 = 1.50; g_se = 0.99994*(0.01/1.50) = 0.00667; g_var = g_se^2. NOTE the 1.50 implied SD is an artifact of rounding ES to 0.01; true SD ~1.0, so g_se may be modestly understated.
effect_sizes.page_ref: Table VI.1 row 2 (p. 64, PDF p.79); discussion p. 64
effect_sizes.notes: Pure one-year RCT contrast on the full randomized sample (134 treatment + 134 control teachers in 66 schools). NOT statistically significant (p=0.25). This is the cleanest single TPD-vs-BAU contrast but at the earlier (1-year) timepoint; impacts emerged only after 2 years. Included so central merge can choose 1-yr vs 2-yr timepoint. Cluster-adjusted via HLM.

effect_sizes.arm_label: TPP - two-year schoolwide impact, all ELA classrooms incl. nonstudy teachers (S7)
effect_sizes.test_name: State ELA assessments, standardized to means/SDs of a national norming population
effect_sizes.timepoint: post, end of schools' second study year
effect_sizes.g_method: Report's effect size = 0.02 taken as d. J with df = 6858 = 0.99989; g = 0.02000. g_se: standardizing SD = coef/ES = 0.017/0.02 = 0.85; g_se = 0.99989*(0.03/0.85) = 0.03529; g_var = g_se^2.
effect_sizes.notes: Schoolwide impact: students of ALL ELA teachers in 2-year schools, including teachers not directly in the study. Different (broader) population than the study-teacher contrasts; positive but NOT significant (p=0.32). is_full_sample=false because it is a distinct schoolwide-population contrast, not the randomized study-teacher sample. Cluster-adjusted.

effect_sizes.arm_label: TPP - one-year follow-up impact, schools NOT in two-year study (S9)
effect_sizes.test_name: State ELA assessments, standardized to means/SDs of a national norming population
effect_sizes.timepoint: follow-up, year after a single year of TPP (TPP discontinued)
effect_sizes.g_method: Report's effect size = 0.06 taken as d. J with df = 6381 = 0.99988; g = 0.05999. g_se: standardizing SD = coef/ES = 0.055/0.06 = 0.9167; g_se = 0.99988*(0.03/0.9167) = 0.03272; g_var = g_se^2.
effect_sizes.page_ref: Table VI.1 row 8 (p. 64, PDF p.79); discussion p. 65
effect_sizes.notes: Persistence/follow-up impact: students of study teachers in schools that got only ONE year of TPP, measured the FOLLOWING year (no continuing TPP). Approaches but does not reach 5% significance (p=0.07). Restricted to one-year-only schools (subset of S4 sample), so is_full_sample=false. Lost significance in complete-case (ES 0.04) sensitivity; stayed ~0.06 in joiner analysis. Cluster-adjusted.

effect_sizes.arm_label: TPP - one-year novice impact, novice teachers' students (S1) [subgroup]
effect_sizes.test_name: State ELA assessments, standardized to means/SDs of a national norming population
effect_sizes.timepoint: post, end of schools' first year of TPP implementation
effect_sizes.g_method: Report's effect size = 0.00 (coefficient -0.003), taken as d=0.00. J with df = 4813 = 0.99984; g = 0.00. ES rounds to 0.00 so standardizing SD cannot be derived from ES; g_se set from coefficient SE assuming SD~1.0: g_se = J*0.02 = ~0.02; g_var = g_se^2. Approximate.
effect_sizes.notes: Subgroup: students of NOVICE ELA teachers (0-3 yrs experience) only, after 1 year. Essentially zero (coef -0.003), not significant (p=0.89). Subgroup, is_full_sample=false. Report cautions novice findings (S1/S5/S8) due to baseline grade-level imbalance. Cluster-adjusted.

effect_sizes.arm_label: TPP - two-year novice impact, novice teachers' students (S5) [subgroup]
effect_sizes.test_name: State ELA assessments, standardized to means/SDs of a national norming population
effect_sizes.timepoint: post, end of novice teachers' second year of TPP engagement
effect_sizes.g_method: Report's effect size = 0.05 taken as d. J with df = 1799 = 0.99958; g = 0.04998. g_se: standardizing SD = coef/ES = 0.047/0.05 = 0.94; g_se = 0.99958*(0.05/0.94) = 0.05317; g_var = g_se^2.
effect_sizes.page_ref: Table VI.1 row 4 (p. 64, PDF p.79); discussion p. 66
effect_sizes.notes: Subgroup: students of NOVICE teachers in their 2nd year of TPP. Positive but NOT significant (p=0.37). Subgroup, is_full_sample=false. Interpret with caution (baseline grade imbalance among novice samples). Cluster-adjusted.

effect_sizes.arm_label: TPP - one-year follow-up novice impact, novice teachers' students, schools NOT in two-year study (S8) [subgroup]
effect_sizes.test_name: State ELA assessments, standardized to means/SDs of a national norming population
effect_sizes.timepoint: follow-up, year after novices' single year of TPP
effect_sizes.g_method: Report's effect size = 0.02 taken as d. J with df = 1714 = 0.99956; g = 0.01999. g_se: standardizing SD = coef/ES = 0.017/0.02 = 0.85; g_se = 0.99956*(0.13/0.85) = 0.15287; g_var = g_se^2.
effect_sizes.notes: Subgroup + follow-up: novice teachers' students in one-year-only schools, measured following year. Not significant (p=0.89); very large SE (0.13) reflecting small subgroup. Subgroup, is_full_sample=false. Cluster-adjusted. Lowest-precision estimate in the table.
